issues.problem: No probe covers the densification statistics: the NDC rescaling (W/2, H/2) and denom += 1/n_renders (official add_densification_stats with d = 1/5 for motion) can be removed without any probe failing.
issues.evidence: motion_blur probe only checks info['means2d'].shape[0] == 5; schedule probe feeds zero gradients.
issues.fix: Add a probe that feeds a known means2d grad for 5 renders with partial visibility and checks grad_accum/denom against the official formula.

issues.problem: No probe checks that add_points and the MLP Adam reset are actually triggered at pts_iter inside after_backward. The extra_points probe calls add_points() directly and checks only the Gaussian Adams. I ran the step 2499 -> 2500 sequence on the GPU and it works: densify, then add points, MLP optimizer state 0, optimizer_resets 1.
issues.fix: Extend the schedule/extra-points probe to drive after_backward at step 2500 and assert added_points > 0 and an empty MLP Adam state.

issues.problem: At step 2500 the runtime and the MLP bank step their optimizers before the densify and add-points step. Official train.py densifies and recreates the optimizer first, so that step's update is effectively skipped. This is documented as a fidelity gap.
issues.evidence: train.py: densify -> add_points -> gaussians.optimizer.step() on the fresh Adam (no grads).
issues.fix: None needed beyond the existing report entry.

issues.problem: Uses an exact 3-NN for the re-initialised scales; simple-knn distCUDA2 is approximate (Morton boxes). The effect is negligible, and it is not listed in the report's gaps.

The gsplat control (30k steps, white background, the runtime's opacity-reset strategy) is not the paper's 3D-GS row protocol, so gain comparisons are only approximate. This is acknowledged in the request.
issues.evidence: smoke config protocol background 'white'; the paper's 3D-GS row is vanilla 3DGS trained on blurry images.
issues.fix: Keep the caveat in the final report; compare absolute PSNR as the primary number.

issues.problem: Official training skips the optimizer step at the final iteration (iteration < opt.iterations); the port steps every iteration, including 20000. Negligible.

equation_coverage.eq: (7) defocus MLP F_theta(gamma(x), r, s, gamma(v))
equation_coverage.note: Follows the code rather than the paper: PE with no pi and include_input (91 channels), camera centre as the view input, inputs detached, 3x64 ReLU trunk, linear heads, xavier gains 0.1 only for out_features in {2,3}, zero bias. Matches blur_kernel.py exactly.

equation_coverage.eq: (9)-(10) r^ = r*clip(lambda_s dr + 1 - lambda_s), s^ likewise
equation_coverage.note: clamp [1, 1.1] as coded. The factor multiplies the normalised quaternion element-wise (q*dr, 4-vector) and the activated scale. Sigma = R(q~) S^2 R(q~)^T with the Inria non-homogeneous rotation formula on the unnormalised q~. The Inria computeCov3D does not normalise ('glm::vec4 q = rot;// / glm::length(rot)'). The port's row-form matrix equals glm's transpose, so Sigma is identical.

equation_coverage.eq: (11)-(12) motion: M sets {x + lambda_p dx_i, r dr_i, s ds_i}, I_b = mean
equation_coverage.note: 5 renders like the code: render 0 at x with ds[...,M]/dr[...,M], renders 1..4 at x + lambda_p dx_i (view(-1,3,M) layouts identical), mean of 5. lambda_s = lambda_p = 0.01 (real_camera_motion.txt).

equation_coverage.eq: supp. N_p = min(prod(Q_max - Q_min)/c^3, N_max); Alg. 1
equation_coverage.note: Initial SfM bbox volume, rate 1.1, cap 2e5, uniform samples in [sorted[10], sorted[-10]] of the current Gaussians, K = 4 among all current Gaussians, strict d < t_d = 2, weights proportional to d (normalised over valid neighbours), all SH. Samples with no valid neighbour are dropped. All Gaussians are re-initialised (3-NN log scales, identity quaternion, opacity 0.1) and every Adam, including the MLP's, is reset.
World z, (z - min)/(max - min)*(3 - 1) + 1, computed after clone/split. Opacity is never reset and there is no size pruning (size_threshold None).
Zero-padded 11x11 sigma 1.5 SSIM, as in Inria loss_utils.

probe_assessment.why: Checks channel count, layer shapes, init std/bias, PE against an independent formula, deltas against a reference forward pass, an active clamp, and detached inputs.

Compares the training render with gsplat(covars from an independent I + 2wK + 2K^2 formula), requires a difference from the renormalised-quaternion render, requires eval to equal the plain render, and requires an MLP gradient.
Requires the training render to equal the mean of 5 independent renders with the official ordering, to differ from a single render, and the position head to receive a gradient.
Brute-force official loop for the kept samples and SH, plus checks of the reinit and Gaussian Adam reset. It does not check that the call is triggered at step 2500 or the MLP reset (minor).
A mid-depth Gaussian with opacity 0.6 t_p survives only with depth weighting.
Checks thresholds, intervals and xyz lr endpoints/log-linearity; opacity is untouched across step 3000.

fidelity_gaps_confirmed: gsplat instead of the Inria rasterizer (same EWA with 0.3 dilation; covariance built in torch, so the unnormalised quaternion is preserved)
train views sampled with replacement instead of a shuffled stack
optimizer step before densification; step 2500 update not skipped
SH degree increments one step later
ss-eval SSIM/LPIPS differ from Deblur-NeRF metrics (skimage SSIM, LPIPS-Alex); PSNR is the comparable number
code-over-paper choices (clamp [1,1.1], 4+1 renders, no pi, camera centre view input, distance-proportional colour weights) all verified against source/code

verified_facts.data: hold files: cake 9, caps 5, ball 7, girl 7. Official Scene reads hold=N (default 8); sorted image_name, idx % hold == 0 -> test. prepare_official reproduces this with sorted stems. Images: full-res 'images/' resized with PIL by -r 4 to 600x400 (official loadCam round(W/4)). Points: the release has no points3D.ply, so the official code converts points3D.bin; native points.npz comes from the same bin (cake 14465, ball 9944, girl 12532). No world reorientation or rescaling in colmap_to_transforms, so t_d = 2 / rate 1.1 / world-z depth act in the same COLMAP units (N_p: cake 200000, caps 200000, ball 30392, girl 200000).
verified_facts.configs: real_defocus: grad 2e-4, prune 5e-3, lambda_s 0.01, -r 4. real_camera_motion: grad 5e-4, prune 1e-2, lambda_s 0.01, lambda_p 0.01, use_pos 1, -r 4. arguments: 20k iters, xyz 1.6e-3 -> 1.6e-5 over 30000 (no delay steps), densify > 500, % 100, < 15000, percent_dense 0.01, prune_range 3, densify_with_depth 1, gtnet_lr 1e-3, Adam eps 1e-15, black background.
verified_facts.test_path: training_report calls render(...) with the default deblur = 0, i.e. the sharp Gaussians. Port: measure() under no_grad, or ACTIVE None in ss-eval, gives render_sharp.
verified_facts.paper_results: Spot-checked against main.tex Tables 1/2 and the supp. LPIPS tables (all four target scenes, the 3D-GS rows and the averages): match.
verified_facts.checks_run: pytest 6 passed; ss-inspect clean; ss-verify deblurring-3dgs-motion declared_checks_passed (GPU 3); GPU check of after_backward at steps 2499 -> 2500 (motion): densify, then add points, MLP Adam state emptied, stats reset.

summary: High-fidelity port. Every equation and schedule item I checked matches the official code: MLP architecture and init, clamp, quaternion factor applied to the normalised quaternion without renormalisation (as the Inria computeCov3D does), 5-render motion averaging with the official ordering, extra-point generation and the full re-initialisation with Adam reset at step 2500, depth-scaled pruning, no opacity reset or size pruning, LR schedule, loss, sharp evaluation, data split, resolution and points. The remaining items are probe coverage gaps (densification statistics, the step-2500 trigger) and small documented ordering and protocol differences. No critical or major issues. Smoke numbers are consistent with evidence/test.json (cake 23.97 vs 23.70, ball 25.20 vs 24.06 at 2k).
